requiredTreatments.finding: Pages 21-30 contain the needed sequence but depend on dense slide layouts, low-resolution copied diagrams, and three external videos.
requiredTreatments.treatment: Rewrite as native explanation, redraw the membrane and voltage models, add a keyboard-operable explorer, and include a complete static equivalent.

requiredTreatments.finding: The source can imply that the sodium-potassium pump directly resets each action potential.
requiredTreatments.treatment: Explain that selective permeability and voltage-gated channels create the rapid voltage phases, while the pump maintains ion gradients over time.

requiredTreatments.finding: Pages 130-131 and legacy text overgeneralize insulin as making all body cells permeable to glucose.
requiredTreatments.treatment: Distinguish insulin-responsive skeletal muscle and adipose uptake from liver glucose handling and insulin-independent uptake in other tissues.

requiredTreatments.finding: Pages 132-133 use age-based type labels and oversimplified treatment statements.
requiredTreatments.treatment: Use current type 1/type 2 terminology, state that either can occur across ages, and describe treatment as individualized rather than prescribed by the course.

requiredTreatments.finding: Urine glucose and ketone patterns can support system reasoning but cannot establish a diagnosis.
requiredTreatments.treatment: Use clearly synthetic instructional data, state limitations, and identify professional blood testing as the diagnostic route.
